title: E-commerce "Fake Door" Test
description: Tested buying intent before inventory spend by capturing interest at checkout.
seoDescription: How a beauty brand tested purchase intent at checkout before investing in inventory, fulfillment, and a full e-commerce build.
constraints: Needed to test real purchase intent without taking payments or buying stock first.
problem: The founders had a promising beauty product idea but faced a costly decision. They needed to test demand before investing in development and inventory.
solution: Built an e-commerce storefront that let the founders test whether visitors would try to buy. Instead of charging at checkout, the site captured email interest at the final step so they could measure intent before committing capital.
result: The founders got a low-risk signal about which products drew the strongest interest. The test also built an early launch list, giving them an audience to contact before they spent on inventory.
